entry_point.code: func (ing Ingress) FindMatchingRule(hostname, path string) (*Rule, int) {

trace.code: if !ing.DisablePathNormalization && (rulesRequireAccess(ing.InternalRules) || rulesRequireAccess(ing.Rules)) { path = canonicalPathForMatching(path) }  // canonicalize the PERCENT-DECODED URL.Path

canonicalPathForMatching: backslash->slash, then path.Clean(p). NO matrix-parameter (';') stripping. /public/.;x/../admin -> path.Clean pops '.;x' and '..' -> /public/admin; /admin;x=/../public (decoded from %2f) -> path.Clean -> /public
first-match loop: the crafted path now matches the EARLIER non-Access /public rule, so Access is never required for the request

FindMatchingRule now takes *url.URL; canonicalPathForMatching = normalizePath(escapedPath, stripPathParameters, decode, normalizeSeparators, resolveDotSegments) — matrix params are stripped BEFORE decoding so encoded separators inside parameter values cannot introduce traversal segments; plus a second decode-first interpretation re-check

preconditions: cloudflared 2026.10.0-2026.10.7 (or master pre-fix) running with path normalization ENABLED — the opt-in `--disable-path-normalization=false` flag or a remotely-managed tunnel whose orchestrator enables normalization (the VULN-141859 fix of 2026-09-29 shipped it disabled by default, to become default in future releases)
Ingress config where a public path rule precedes a protected (Access) path rule — the standard 'public part of the site + Access-gated admin' layout

The origin (or any hop downstream of cloudflared) interprets matrix parameters (';') and dot-segments the way Tomcat/Jetty and Servlet-style servers do, so the crafted URL resolves to the protected resource
Attacker can send arbitrary HTTP requests to the tunnel (no credentials needed)

evidence.vulnerable_version: cloudflared 2026.10.0-2026.10.7 with path normalization enabled (opt-in --disable-path-normalization=false, or remotely-managed tunnels with normalization on; the VULN-141859 normalization landed 2026-09-29 disabled by default)
evidence.observed_result: Rules: #0 /public (no Access), #1 /admin (Access REQUIRED), #2 catch-all. The verbatim vulnerable FindMatchingRule+canonicalPathForMatching route /public/.;x/../admin, /admin;x=%2f..%2fpublic, /admin;x=%2F..%2Fpublic and /public\..;x\admin to rule #0 (NO Access) — a full Access bypass, since the origin (Servlet-style) serves /admin. The verbatim fixed pipeline routes all four to rule #1 (Access REQUIRED). DIFFERENTIAL PASS.
evidence.notes: No public CVE/GHSA for VULN-170057 as of 2026-11-12. Normalization is opt-in in public releases (DisablePathNormalization defaults true since the 2026-09-29 VULN-141859 fix; TUNNEL_DISABLE_PATH_NORMALIZATION), hence AC:H. cloudflared is Apache-2.0; the PoC compiles the verbatim vulnerable (872b241f9487) and fixed (3106f9499d6a) matching code with minimal type stubs. Critic (dedicated subagent) PASS with Tomcat 9.0.71 origin verification.
